machineScope.reason: Durable no-replace records belong to the local installation setup. Threadline also uses this writer for public identity and encrypted staging: Encrypted local spool is staging only, capped at 1024 frames; consumed staging is reclaimed only once its information is durably recoverable and replicated. Authoritative sends, reads and accepted payloads are in the existing encrypted journal and follow its replication demand before frame dispatch or receipt release. Identity derives from the installation storage key and enters existing custody. Private routes are owner-signed machine-local filesystem paths; moving a route needs an updated signed binding, never a new identity or automatic resend. The runtime caps active unresolved sends plus unread intake at 4096; new-admission capacity refusal preserves accepted-intake draining, repeated reads and status recovery regardless of retained history.
